note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), who transcribed the descriptions of Krishna (1965) and Akhtar (1975); the original is in English, alate and soldier known, worker not described; the alate postclypeus length is given in the original as '0.'1. 8-0.23', with fused and defective digits, and is therefore not recorded; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, widest at the antennal bases; mandibles short and thick, base very wide, about half the head length, each with a small tooth situated at about the apical third; postmentum club-shaped and slender, waist near the posterior margin; pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior and posterior margins both convex and without a median notch. Alate head capsule dark brown, with a small pale spot in front of the fontanelle plate and an ocellus-like pale spot in front of each ocellus, head and body covered with dense short hairs and a few longer setae. Worker not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown; postclypeus pale yellow, anteclypeus paler; mandibles reddish brown, paler at the base; antennae pale yellow; pronotum yellow; abdomen white. Head densely covered with short hairs and scattered with long setae, pronotum with slightly fewer hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide; head length to mandible base 1.43–1.51 mm, maximum width 1.14–1.21 mm; widest at the antennal bases. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 nearly equal to segment 2 in length, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus with pilosity similar to that of the head, elliptical; anteclypeus hairless, slightly projecting anteriorly in the middle. Labrum wide, dome-shaped, wider than long. Mandibles short and thick, base very wide; length 0.67–0.80 mm, about half the head length; each with a small tooth situated at about the apical third, tooth distance from apex 0.23–0.29 mm. Postmentum club-shaped and slender; length 0.91–1.04 mm, maximum width 0.37–0.46 mm, waist width 0.23–0.26 mm; waist near the posterior margin. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe convex, without a median notch; posterior margin also convex, without a notch; length 0.38–0.39 mm, width 0.65–0.68 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule dark brown, with a small pale spot in front of the fontanelle plate and an ocellus-like pale spot in front of the ocellus; postclypeus paler than the head; antennae light brown; labrum pale yellow; pronotum brown, paler than the head; legs yellowish brown; abdominal dorsum brown, paler than the head, venter even paler. Head and body covered with dense short hairs and a few longer setae; wing surface with fine hairs. Head subcircular, wider than the head length to mandible base; head length 0.72–0.94 mm, maximum width including eyes 1.06–1.22 mm; sutures weak. Fontanelle small, circular, transparent, situated medially. Eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.27–0.31 mm, distance from the lower margin 0.05–0.08 mm. Ocelli circular to broadly oval, length 0.10–0.13 mm, width 0.09–0.10 mm; distance to the eye slightly less than to slightly more than their diameter (0.06–0.12 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus hairy, weakly raised, length slightly less than half its width; width 0.44–0.49 mm. Anteclypeus transparent, hairless, sub-trapezoidal, slightly projecting anteriorly in the middle. Labrum wide, tongue-shaped. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head; length 0.64–0.71 mm, width 0.96–1.22 mm; anterior margin nearly straight or slightly curved inward, without a median notch; posterior margin slightly concave.
